Palestinian Photographer Wins Bayeux Prize

Palestinian photographer Mahmoud Abu Hamda has won a top photography prize at the Bayeux-Calvados-Normandy awards. Other prizes were awarded to The Washington Post, NPR, and CNN for their reporting from Ukraine, Gaza, and the West Bank.
